A major blow was just dealt to the Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG). This wasn’t just some crude hole in the ground made by amateurs. It was a sophisticated tunnel system they were counting on to smuggle billions of dollars worth of drugs and weapons. 
 
Smuggling tunnels have been a challenge along the border for decades. Cartels have gotten better at making them, but we’re getting better at hunting them down thanks to enhanced intelligence capabilities and stronger cooperation with Mexico.

Lots of Americans are always looking for some deep explanation for why we have enemies. Usually it involves blaming ourselves for some imagined transgression.
 
The truth is much simpler than that:
 
Jihadists choose to be our adversaries. Putin chooses to be our adversary. Xi chooses to be our adversary.
 
Not because of some specific American policy or mistake. Because our values, interests, and vision for the world are fundamentally incompatible with theirs.
